decisions.reason: The encrypted second channel is core to the firm's stated direction of trusted second-channel communication, so it likely meets aspirations in a growing industry, and R&D slack lets the firm carry it.
The multi-layer end-to-end security architecture was promoted to its own page in 2019, which signals satisfactory results and a central role in the firm's integrated security offer.
The QR-code hardware token gained its own page in 2019 and supports the regulatory demand for strong authentication, though its hardware nature carries some risk of falling short of aspirations.

The payment compliance suite builds on the established offer and serves continuing regulatory demand, but it was only ever mentioned rather than featured, so its performance is less certain than the core products.
